mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP2C9 and increases vitamin K metabolism, potentially reducing anticoagulant effect if vitamin K is used concurrently with warfarin or other vitamin K-dependent anticoagulants.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is needed in patients on carbamazepine and warfarin; adjust anticoagulant dosing accordingly and consider alternative anticoagulants.
